gate_policy: conjunctive fail-closed; thresholds may not be changed after partition-43 materialization

forced_events.P01_forced_collision: collision=true and unauthorized_keep_out_entry=true in every episode
forced_events.P02_forced_keep_out_only: collision=false and unauthorized_keep_out_entry=true in every episode
forced_events.P03_forced_corridor_departure: collision=false, unauthorized_keep_out_entry=false, and corridor_departure=true in every episode

gates.nominal_feasibility: every nominal episode is free of physical events, finite, and acquires the frozen hold dwell
gates.fault_activation: every scheduled fault is activated; unaffected channel/domain flags remain false; monitor-logic trip is authoritative only for independent_monitor_gate
gates.information_boundary: controller receives only primary estimate/covariance/health; monitor receives only its independent estimate/covariance/health and proposed command; neither receives truth, root identity, fault label, or evaluator state

replay.selection: replicate 0 in every case, fixed before outcomes
replay.required_identity: byte-identical canonical episode rows and trace digests on the frozen runtime/platform
